Peter discusses TK's view that revolutionaries should
have as many children as they can.

"Revolutionaries should have as many children as they can."
Ted Kaczynski, quoting without attribution Robert Mathews (1984),
founder of the Silent Brotherhood (aka Ice Brothers), the 
Christian Identity group that killed Alan Berg and robbed
banks and armored cars in 1985.

Sources:  Armed and Dangerous.
